datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Mozambique on a monthly basis throughout 2012 (January, April, July, October). The classifications were spatially referenced to administrative or livelihood zones and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) to represent the spatial distribution of food insecurity phases as a loss/impact indicator.
